title: TrainingPeaks Workout Training Stress Leaderboard
dataSources: TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), Garmin multisport activities (`garmin:multisport`), TriDot plans (`tridot:plan`), brick workouts (`brick:workout`), and transition logs (`transition:log`).
app: TrainingPeaks structured workouts, Garmin multisport FIT exports, TriDot training plans, brick workout logs, and transition timing notes ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=trainingpeaks:workout tss=*
| stats sum(tss) as total_value, avg(tss) as avg_value by sport
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks sport values by total and average training stress across TrainingPeaks workout events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `tss` values for each TrainingPeaks workout event and review total and average training stress by sport.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total training stress.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which sport shows the biggest training stress numbers in your TrainingPeaks workout data.
